cards.example_en: A wedding is a special occasion.
cards.example_zh: 婚礼是一个特殊的场合。

cards.example_en: Nursing became her occupation after years of hospital work.
cards.example_zh: 在医院工作多年以后，护理成了她的职业。

cards.example_en: The meeting occupied the whole morning.
cards.example_zh: 会议占了整整一个上午。

cards.example_en: Power cuts often occur during summer storms in our town.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇上夏天暴风雨时经常发生停电。

cards.example_en: An odd noise came from the fridge at midnight.
cards.example_zh: 半夜冰箱里传来一阵奇怪的响声。

cards.example_en: An official explained the new rule.
cards.example_zh: 一位官员解释了新规定。

cards.example_en: She dreams of running in the Olympics.
cards.example_zh: 她梦想参加奥运会赛跑。

cards.example_en: The cat jumped onto the kitchen table and stole the fish.
cards.example_zh: 猫跳到厨房的桌子上，把鱼偷走了。

cards.example_en: Doctors said the operation would take about two hours.
cards.example_zh: 医生说这个手术大约需要两个小时。

cards.example_en: The radio operator sent our location when the boat stalled.
cards.example_zh: 船停住以后，无线电操作员发出了我们的位置。

cards.example_en: Respect your opponent after the match.
cards.example_zh: 比赛后要尊重对手。

cards.example_en: The contest is a good opportunity to show your speaking skills.
cards.example_zh: 这次比赛是展示你口语能力的好机会。

cards.example_en: Many parents oppose closing the school library on Saturdays.
cards.example_zh: 许多家长反对星期六关闭学校图书馆。

cards.example_en: She stayed optimistic about the result.
cards.example_zh: 她对结果保持乐观。

cards.example_en: Staying home was the safer option during the heavy snow.
cards.example_zh: 下大雪时，待在家里是更安全的选择。

cards.example_en: The satellite is in orbit around Earth.
cards.example_zh: 卫星在绕地球的轨道上。

cards.example_en: We ate ordinary bread and soup for dinner at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家晚饭吃了普通的面包和汤。

cards.example_en: The heart is a vital organ.
cards.example_zh: 心脏是重要器官。

cards.example_en: They buy organic vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 他们购买有机蔬菜。

cards.example_en: The aid organisation brought clean water to the flooded streets.
cards.example_zh: 援助组织给被淹的街道送来了干净的水。

cards.example_en: The origin of this custom is a harvest feast long ago.
cards.example_zh: 这个习俗的起源是很久以前的一场收获宴。

cards.example_en: That's a really original idea.
cards.example_zh: 这是一个非常有创意的想法。

cards.example_en: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.
cards.example_zh: 快点，否则我们会迟到。

cards.example_en: You ought to review these words tonight.
cards.example_zh: 你今晚应该复习这些词。

cards.example_en: We waited nervously for the outcome of the singing contest.
cards.example_zh: 我们紧张地等待歌唱比赛的结果。

cards.example_en: My outgoing friend talks to everyone.
cards.example_zh: 我那位外向的朋友和谁都聊得来。

cards.example_en: The captain will outline the match plan before kickoff.
cards.example_zh: 队长会在开球前概述比赛计划。

cards.example_en: The bakery's output of bread rises before the Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 春节前，这家面包店的面包产量会上升。

cards.example_en: Maya gave an outstanding performance in the school play.
cards.example_zh: 玛雅在校园剧中的表演非常出色。

cards.example_en: The overall result was better than last year.
cards.example_zh: 总体结果比去年好。

cards.example_en: She managed to overcome her fear of speaking in class.
cards.example_zh: 她设法克服了在课堂上发言的恐惧。

cards.example_en: Her sister studies overseas.
cards.example_zh: 她姐姐在海外学习。

cards.example_en: I owe my sister ten yuan for yesterday's bus ticket.
cards.example_zh: 昨天的公交车票钱，我还欠姐姐十元。

cards.example_en: People need oxygen to live.
cards.example_zh: 人需要氧气才能生存。

cards.example_en: He kept a steady pace and finished the cross-country run.
cards.example_zh: 他保持稳定的步伐，跑完了越野赛。

cards.example_en: Huge waves in the Pacific delayed the cargo ship for days.
cards.example_zh: 太平洋上的巨浪把货船耽搁了好几天。

cards.example_en: A package arrived this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上到了一个包裹。

cards.example_en: Heat the pan before you add oil.
cards.example_zh: 加油前先把锅烧热。

cards.example_en: Press the green button on the panel to start the printer.
cards.example_zh: 按下面板上的绿色按钮，就能启动打印机。

cards.example_en: Don't panic if you miss the first bus.
cards.example_zh: 如果没赶上第一班公交，也不要恐慌。

cards.example_en: The parcel was damaged, but the books inside were fine.
cards.example_zh: 包裹破损了，不过里面的书还是完好的。

cards.example_en: There is free parking at the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 超市提供免费停车位。

cards.example_en: All students are encouraged to participate.
cards.example_zh: 鼓励所有学生参与。

cards.example_en: Is there a particular seat you want on the bus?
cards.example_zh: 公交车上有没有你特别想坐的座位？

cards.example_en: Chess is her passion, so she practises before breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 国际象棋是她的热情所在，所以她早饭前都要练习。

cards.example_en: Don't stay passive; ask a question.
cards.example_zh: 别一直被动，问个问题。

cards.example_en: The company owns a patent for the device.
cards.example_zh: 公司拥有这项装置的专利。

cards.example_en: A muddy path leads from the back gate to the field.
cards.example_zh: 一条泥泞的小路从后门通向操场。

cards.example_en: Teaching young children takes patience.
cards.example_zh: 教小孩子需要耐心。

cards.example_en: Those curtains show a pattern of blue birds.
cards.example_zh: 那些窗帘上是蓝色小鸟的图案。

word.example_en: It is hard to keep pace with new terms.
word.example_zh: 很难与新术语同步前进。
